processing.axis_order: Original: easting/northing metres; output geometry: longitude/latitude degrees (always_xy=True).
processing.method: Select by exact normalized name/type; validate without repairs; planar area and area-weighted centroid in EPSG:32721; reproject polygon vertices and metric centroid to EPSG:4326.
processing.modifications: Single feature extracted; derived geometry, bounding boxes, centroid and approximate planar area. No simplification, snapping or vertical transformation.
